exposure: Impaired maternal glucose metabolism during pregnancy
cohort: A single infant diagnosed with both dextro-transposition of the great arteries and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
finding: A longitudinal multi-disciplinary approach, from fetal diagnosis to post-operative management, can lead to an excellent outcome in infants with rare and severe cardiac malformations such as the combination of dextro-transposition of the great arteries and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
